name: Z.ai API
note: Use the Z.AI REST API for OpenAI-compatible chat completions, coding assistance, structured generation, tool calling, and streaming responses. The environment variable ZAI_API_KEY is available. The base URL is https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 and authentication uses the Authorization: Bearer $ZAI_API_KEY header. Verify the key with a minimal POST to /chat/completions using model glm-5.3, one short user message, stream false, and a low max_tokens value. Core operations include chat completions, streaming completions, tool/function calling, multimodal requests where supported, and reasoning/thinking mode where supported by the selected model. Example: curl -sS --request POST --url 'https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/chat/completions' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ZAI_API_KEY' --data '{"model":"glm-5.3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"stream":false,"max_tokens":16}'. Do not assume model availability or request fields; check the documentation first: https://docs.z.ai/api-reference/introduction and https://docs.z.ai/api-reference/llm/chat-completion.
